mapper.select: SELECT hlia.document_name, hlia.description, hlia.copies, hlia.source_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'LEASE_SOURCE_TYPE' and scv.value = hlia.source_type) source_type_n, hlia.lease_item_attachment_id, hlia.lease_item_id, (select wm_concat(fa.attachment_id) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT' and hlia.lease_item_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) attachment_id, (select wm_concat(fa.file_name) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT' and hlia.lease_item_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) file_name, (select max(fa.creation_date) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT' and hlia.lease_item_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value) upload_date, (select max(su.description) from fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam, sys_user su where fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id and fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT' and hlia.lease_item_attachment_id = fam.table_pk_value and su.user_id = fa.created_by) upload_person FROM HLS_LEASE_ITEM_ATTACHMENT hlia where hlia.lease_item_id = #{leaseItemId}
